title: merge --review-record names a record it cannot read
why: On 2026-11-10 17:24 CST triage posted #1338's round 1 record with one added Finding line. merge then skipped that record as unreadable and judged an older one, so --fix-check was refused with the wrong reason (the newest record has a Fix check line). Removing the line fixed it. Guard: when the newest review-record comment does not parse, merge says so and names its id, instead of falling back to an older record.
